verdict.rationale: The evidence shows backtesting: running draft flows or scenario versions against your own history to see the alerts they would have raised. It also shows clearance rules that leave an audit trail. Neither documents measuring detection quality (for example, hit rates or missed detections) or incorrect clearances against labelled validation cases, so these features are adjacent rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can measure detection quality and incorrect clearances against labelled validation cases
